name: Colin Allred

self_description: Pitches himself as a pragmatic coalition-builder; 2024 ad called him 'tough' and 'standing up to extremists in both parties'; in 2026 said 'Democrats need to put forward what they're for and what they're against.'
primary_context: Beat incumbent Rep. Julie Johnson (displaced from TX-32 by redistricting; backed by AOC, Jeffries and New Dem Action Fund) ~55-45 in the 26 May 2026 runoff after leading the 3 March primary 45.5-34. Contest centred on ICE: Allred moved left to call for abolishing ICE and attacked Johnson's Palantir stock; Johnson called him a 'flip-flopper' over his 2024 Laken Riley Act and anti-sanctuary votes.

L3.e: Opposed Medicare for All in Jan 2024 Senate primary debate vs Roland Gutierrez (who backed near-single-payer); historically backs a public option.

L7.e: 2024 Senate ad and debate: 'I don't want boys playing girls' sports.'

L9.e: 2026 immigration agenda: 'Colin will fight to abolish ICE' - pass legislation to abolish ICE and transfer functions to FBI/DEA/CBP/new civil agency; 'ICE has to go... abolish ICE, whatever you want to call it.'

L12.e: Jan 2024: opposed an unconditional Gaza ceasefire ('a ceasefire is not a magical term'); 2024 campaign touted backing from both AIPAC and J Street. 2025 criticised Israeli war aims but no genocide/embargo language found.

C2.e: Opposed Medicare for All in 2024 Senate primary debate; supports a Medicare buy-in/public option building on ACA.

C4.e: CONFLICT: voted for Laken Riley Act, No Sanctuary Cities Act and a 2024 GOP resolution condemning Biden border policy, but in 2026 campaigns on abolishing ICE; net 0.

C6.e: 2024 Senate ad/debate: 'I don't want boys playing girls' sports' (drew criticism from LGBTQ advocates).

C7.e: Documented record of breaking with party on border votes (Laken Riley Act; one of 14 Dems backing Jan 2024 resolution condemning Biden border policy); 'I've built broad coalitions'.

EPD.note: Former 3-term U.S. Rep and 2024 Senate nominee (office 3); Berkeley JD + NFL/HUD career (cred 2); detailed written plans naming specific bills (12-point anti-corruption plan, affordability agenda, immigration agenda with Dream and Promise Act, End For-Profit Private Prisons Act, etc.) (policy 2).

EO.note: 2026 cycle: per a rival campaign's petition, Allred (and Johnson) skipped the 'singular sanctioned debate' of the TX-33 primary; they appeared only in separately recorded Lone Star Politics (NBC5/DMN) segments; no 2026 general-election debate with Gillespie found (search budget ran out, so not exhaustive). Prior cycles: debated Cruz (2024) and Gutierrez (2024 primary). Regular mainstream TV/press interviews incl. Fox affiliates; engages critiques of his record (defended past ICE votes as made under a different DHS).

outside_support: AI-industry super PAC (~$400K for him in runoff, per Texas Tribune)
AIPAC and J Street support claimed in 2024 Senate race (not verified for 2026)
notable_positions: Abolish ICE and transfer its functions to FBI/DEA, CBP and a new civil agency; end for-profit detention (https://colinallred.com/immigration)

Opposes Medicare for All; public option/Medicare negotiation of all drug prices and march-in rights (https://www.texastribune.org/2024/01/28/texas-senate-democratic-debate/; https://colinallred.com/affordability)
Federal price-gouging ban on groceries; repeal Trump tariffs; close 'billionaire hedge fund loophole' (https://colinallred.com/affordability)
12-point anti-corruption plan: ban member stock trading, ban corporate PAC money, overturn Citizens United, independent redistricting commissions (https://colinallred.com/corruption)
2024: 'I don't want boys playing girls' sports' (https://www.fox26houston.com/news/allred-cruz-attack-ad-i-dont-want-boys-playing-girls-sports)
Opposed unconditional Gaza ceasefire in 2024 (https://www.texastribune.org/2024/01/28/texas-senate-democratic-debate/)

Highly credentialed (EPD 7) and media-engaged but skipped the only 2026 primary debate (EO 3), so falls to step 5 'nearest' = Cat 4, flagged imperfect fit given the 2026 leftward turn on ICE.
